about: Pairs of a label and a value, down the list or across it. A summary panel, a settled form and the details beside a record are made of them.

components.about: A value is often a component: a status, a code span, or a figure with a note after it. An identifier wraps at any character, so it never widens the list.
components.title: Values that are components

divided.about: A hairline between the pairs, as far from each pair as the gap between them. Use it where values run onto several lines, so each value stays with its label.
divided.title: Divided

net.label: Net amount
net.note: What is paid out after fees and any held balance.

notes.about: A label that needs explaining takes a note beside it. The note opens on a press, so a reader on a touch screen or with a keyboard reaches it, and Escape closes it.
notes.title: A note beside a label

orientation.about: Down the list, the label is above its value. Across it, the labels form one column as wide as the widest label, at most 40% of the list, and every value starts at the same position.
orientation.title: Orientations

size.about: The text and the gaps step together: 12.6, 14.2 and 16px text, 8, 12 and 16px between the pairs, and 12, 16 and 24px between the columns across the list.
size.title: Sizes

title: Data list

variant.about: `subtle` mutes the label, so the value reads first, as in a summary. `bold` sets the label in the label weight and mutes the value, as in a form of settled answers.
variant.title: Variants

window.label: Settlement window
window.note: Working days, counted from the day the payout was raised.
